title: Steve Rude's The Moth Free Comic Book Day 2008 Special Issue Rude Dude
conditionDescription: Cover clean and bright with no creases or tears; light handling wear. Retailer stamp box on the cover is blank. See photos.
descriptionText:
Steve Rude's The Moth - Free Comic Book Day 2008 Special Issue (May 3, 2008), Rude Dude Productions. Featuring "The Moth's Greatest Hits", with story and art by Steve Rude.

The "Brought to you by" retailer box on the cover is blank (no shop stamp).

Back cover: Steve Rude: Artist in Motion (Flesk Publications) art book ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
